title: For each publisher that has published at least one 'Good' aligned superhero
question: For each publisher that has published at least one 'Good' aligned superhero, calculate the average height of their 'Good' aligned superheroes and rank these publishers by that average height in descending order. Return only the top 3 publishers.

SELECT 
    p.XCL_015 AS publisher_name,
    AVG(ha.XCL_011) AS average_height
FROM publisher p
JOIN superhero s ON p.XCL_014 = s.XCL_026
JOIN alignment a ON s.XCL_027 = a.XCL_001
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN attribute at ON ha.XCL_010 = at.XCL_003
WHERE a.XCL_002 = 'Good'
  AND at.XCL_004 = 'Height'
GROUP BY p.XCL_014
ORDER BY average_height DESC
